title: "Analysis Overview"
---


## Select a method from the question

The templates are teaching components. Read `ANALYSIS_GUIDE.md` in your generated project for required variables, assumptions, NCDB pitfalls, code behavior and interpretation for every script. The synthetic demo tests mechanics; it does not validate a clinical analysis.

| Task | Begin with | Decision that must precede code |
|---|---|---|
| Understand the cohort | [Missingness](missingness.qmd), [descriptive summaries](descriptive.qmd) | Denominators, coding validity and eligibility |
| Describe group characteristics | [Table 1](descriptive.qmd) | Category definitions and missingness reporting |
| Model a binary endpoint | [Logistic regression](regression.qmd) | Outcome window, confounders, encoding and functional form |
| Describe time to event | [Kaplan–Meier](survival.qmd) | Time origin, event/censor coding and groups |
| Adjust a time-to-event comparison | [Cox regression](survival.qmd) | PH, timing, confounders and facility correlation |
| Balance measured baseline covariates | [Propensity methods](propensity.qmd) | Target estimand, overlap, design and inference |
| Challenge assumptions | [Sensitivity analyses](sensitivity.qmd) | Named assumption and justified alternate rule |
| Develop prediction | [Machine learning](machine_learning.qmd) | Prediction target, time horizon and validation strategy |

## Use an explicit sequence

Define the question and protocol → verify variables → import and audit → build the cohort → recode → inspect missingness and Table 1 → implement the approved primary analysis → assess diagnostics → run prespecified sensitivities → review outputs and reporting.

Real-data model helpers do not select covariates, drop missing rows, tune definitions or publish results. Facility clustering, missing-data alternatives, causal estimands and treatment timing require additional study-specific implementation and expert review.
